# OpenProgram 0.1.0 Release Notes

Original version date: March 31, 2026. The project was named **LLM Agent Harness** at the time. This was the first version in the line that later became OpenProgram. This historical Release was added retroactively; no Git tag or downloadable installer existed for it.

## ✨ New features

- Added the `@agentic_function` decorator, which records function execution in a Context tree.
- Added synchronous and asynchronous Runtime APIs with text, image, audio, and file content blocks.
- Added Context tree summaries, tree views, error chains, and Markdown/JSONL persistence.
- Added five rendering levels: trace, detail, summary, result, and silent.
- Added automatic persistence of execution records after completion.
- Added the first examples for the Gemini and Claude Code CLIs.

## 📦 Availability

This historical version had no formal installer or complete product entry point for ordinary users. Its source state corresponds to commit [`02bb6f1`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/commit/02bb6f1b530df9250b556fb9a1edb58575803d89). Install the latest stable Release for current use.
